item.title: President appreciates Leader's message on occasion of Government Week
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – In a message acknowledging the communication from Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, on the occasion of Government Week, Masoud Pezeshkian, the President of the Islamic Republic of Iran, emphasized that we assure the great nation of Iran and the cherished Leadership that, in complete unity and cohesion with the other branches of government, we will safeguard the country's authority and dignity as we pursue a path of flourishing and progress.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86248783/President-appreciates-Leader-s-message-on-occasion-of-Government

Tehran, IRNA – In a message acknowledging the communication from Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, on the occasion of Government Week, Masoud Pezeshkian, the President of the Islamic Republic of Iran, emphasized that we assure the great nation of Iran and the cherished Leadership that, in complete unity and cohesion with the other branches of government, we will safeguard the country's authority and dignity as we pursue a path of flourishing and progress.

item.title: Leader: Key to solving economic issues lies in domestic production, getting rid of dollar
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojataba Hosseini Khamenei hailed the administration of President Masoud Pezeshkian for handling the people’s needs amid the US-Israeli aggression and blockade, urging increased domestic production and eliminating the US dollar from transactions.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86248750/Leader-Key-to-solving-economic-issues-lies-in-domestic-production

Tehran, IRNA – Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojataba Hosseini Khamenei hailed the administration of President Masoud Pezeshkian for handling the people’s needs amid the US-Israeli aggression and blockade, urging increased domestic production and eliminating the US dollar from transactions.
